thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: paging: elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected for tenant HalcyonHealth on dedicated-pool-eu-west-1 (error rate 6.2%, p95 latency 1.8s). Investigate and mitigate.

Ryan (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Giving a quick health check.

Jordan (sre): pulling metrics now. seeing KV eviction spikes and host i/o saturation on nodes node-eu-12/13. NVMe write qdepth high, RX/TX normal. Also a sustained queue length on the serving runtime.

Maya (infra): curious — any recent rollout? deploybot?

DeployBot: Deployment "runtime-flags/2026-03-15" to pool eu-west-1 succeeded at 03:05 UTC (no failures).

Ryan (oncall): ok not a rollout. Who's using those nodes? tenant mapping shows HalcyonHealth colocated with DataSynthX on the same GPU pool.

Jordan (sre): DataSynthX traces show large KV churn (many prefix evictions) and heavy seq-len-sim workloads. Looks like noisy neighbor causing cache thrash.

Ella (eng-runtime): that lines up with the increased backend retries -> gateway 502/504s. Runtime is spilling to disk due to KV thrash. We need to reduce tail-latency quickly. Options: 1) reroute HalcyonHealth to a different pool, 2) isolate DataSynthX, 3) throttle DataSynthX, 4) temporary per-tenant cache reservation.

Ryan (oncall): quick mitigation: can we route HalcyonHealth to dedicated-pool-eu-west-2 (has spare cap)? Maya, can you validate capacity and open a short-circuit route?

Maya (infra): checking capacity. spare GPUs in eu-west-2: 3 nodes, can accept HalcyonHealth burst if we reduce batch sizes. I'll spin up a routing rule. ETA ~6m.

Jordan (sre): also preparing node-level mitigation: marking noisy hosts and reducing kernel writeback pressure. Running diagnostics.

Ryan (oncall): CS-Halcyon — we'll update the customer. Priya, please draft a short note.

CS-Halcyon: thanks. HalcyonHealth reports request timeouts from 03:10 — impact on webhook callbacks. They want an ETA.

Priya (oncall-next): drafting: "We're aware of elevated errors and timeouts for HalcyonHealth on eu-west-1. Engineers are actively mitigating by rerouting traffic and addressing noisy-tenant patterns. We'll update within 15 minutes"

Maya (infra): created route rule: `route add override tenant=HalcyonHealth -> pool=dedicated-pool-eu-west-2 weight=100 ttl=600`

Ryan (oncall): applying now.

Ella (eng-runtime): also applying a temporary cache reservation for HalcyonHealth: `runtimectl tenant-reserve --tenant HalcyonHealth --kv=256MB` — this will reduce eviction pressure.

Jordan (sre): running quick drain on most saturated host (node-eu-12) to move DataSynthX shards off. Command:
```
kubectl cordon node-eu-12
kubectl drain node-eu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

Ryan (oncall): executed drain. note: using force drain may briefly increase load on adjacent nodes. monitoring.

DeployBot: Route override accepted and propagated to edge proxies at 03:18 UTC.

Jordan (sre): metrics update: HalcyonHealth 5xx dropped from 6.2% -> 2.1% within 60s of reroute. KV evictions on node-eu-12 spiked then started to decline after cordon.

CS-Halcyon: passing to their ops — they see fewer timeouts but still some intermittent 504s. They appreciate the update.

Ryan (oncall): good. continue to watch for 10 more minutes. If error <1% and p95 <800ms we can close page and hand off.

Maya (infra): observing eu-west-2 node utilization: CPU and GPU util at 68% post-reroute, acceptable. No immediate autoscale triggers.

Jordan (sre): log snippet of tail errors for context:
```
[2026-03-15T03:16:21Z] tenant=HalcyonHealth request_id=abc123 gateway: upstream timeout after 15000ms
[2026-03-15T03:16:22Z] tenant=DataSynthX kv: eviction key=<prefix> old_size=1024 new_size=128
```

Ella (eng-runtime): follow-up remediation: schedule a tenant isolation migration for DataSynthX off mixed pools, and add per-tenant KV quotas to avoid cross-tenant thrash. I'll create an RFC ticket.

Ryan (oncall): acknowledgement. Creating incident ticket INC-2491 with actions: reroute done, drain executed, cache reservation applied, follow-up: isolation + quotas.

Priya (oncall-next): I'm taking the handoff. Current state: HalcyonHealth errors 0.9% (down from 6.2%), p95 620ms. Will monitor for 1 hour and escalate if regress. Handoff notes: route override TTL 600s (auto-refresh by infra), node-eu-12 remains cordoned. Links: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/ops/d/serve-hw/halcyon-health, logs: https://logs.redwood/halcyon/stream?from=2491234567.

Ryan (oncall): thanks Priya. CS will keep the customer updated. I'll follow up on the RFC for quotas.

CS-Halcyon: Thanks everyone — they're seeing normal traffic now. Please keep us posted if you plan any changes.

IncidentBot: Incident resolved: mitigation successful, monitoring handoff to oncall-next. Please file post-incident report within 48h.

Priya (oncall-next): noted, will keep watch. assigning follow-up owner: Ella for quotas and Jordan for post-mortem metrics.

(reacted :thumbsup: by Ryan, Priya, Jordan)
